meta.author:
讚美之泉
詞、曲：曾祥怡

lines.a: 每個狂風暴雨裡 祢同在在那裡
lines.b: When I'm in the raging storm, You're always there for me

lines.a: 每個難處低谷裡 祢恩典在那裡
lines.b: When I'm in the valleys deep, Your grace flows like a stream

lines.a: 每個傷心失望裡 祢愛我愛到底
lines.b: Pain may cause my heart to faint, but Your love never fails

lines.a: 在祢愛的光中 我得著能力
lines.b: In the dawn of Your love, I receive Your strength

lines.a: 我愛祢 用盡我全心全意全力
lines.b: I love You with all my heart, my soul, and my strength

lines.a: 榮耀高舉祢的名 我跟隨不懷疑
lines.b: Lord, I glorify Your name with faith that never sways

lines.a: 我愛祢 用盡我全心全意全力
lines.b: I love You with all my heart, my soul, and my strength

lines.a: 在這愛的路程裡 我奔跑不放棄
lines.b: In this journey filled with grace, I won't give up the race

lines.a: 四面受敵 卻不被困住
lines.b: Affliction may come, we won't grow weary

lines.a: 心裡作難 卻不至失望
lines.b: Wasting away, we will not lose heart

lines.a: 至暫至輕的苦楚要成就
lines.b: All these troubles one day soon will pass
Eternal glory will be our reward

lines.a: 在這愛的路程裡 我奔跑不放棄
lines.b: In this journey filled with grace, I won't give up the race
